scenes.say: A supreme leader killed. A strait choked.
Here's the Iran war in 60 seconds.
scenes.speak: Here's the Iran war in sixty seconds.

scenes.say: 28 February: the US and Israel launch nearly 900 strikes in 12 hours.
scenes.label: Strikes in 12 hours
scenes.speak: The twenty-eighth of February: the US and Israel launch nearly nine hundred strikes in twelve hours.

scenes.say: Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is killed.
But the regime hardens. His son Mojtaba takes over.
Iran chokes the Strait of Hormuz. Traffic falls 90 per cent.
scenes.speak: Iran chokes the Strait of Hormuz. Traffic falls ninety per cent.

scenes.say: Oil jumps from 70 dollars to over 100.
scenes.speak: Oil jumps from seventy dollars to over a hundred.

scenes.say: Hezbollah joins. In Lebanon, 11 lakh people flee.
scenes.label: Displaced in Lebanon
scenes.speak: Hezbollah joins. In Lebanon, eleven lakh people flee.

scenes.say: April: a ceasefire. June: a deal. July: it collapses.
More than 4,000 dead in Lebanon. Nearly 3,500 in Iran.
scenes.title: By official counts
scenes.speak: More than four thousand dead in Lebanon. Nearly three and a half thousand in Iran.

scenes.say: Now, with elections in Israel and the US, the threats are back.
